name: NeRF-In
definition: A simple 3D inpainting method that trains a NeRF using pixel reconstruction loss, guided by 2D inpainted images generated by an MST inpainting network.
summary: NeRF-In removes objects from 3D scenes by training a NeRF to match 2D inpainted images and depth maps from a Masked Scene Transformer, differing from methods that rely solely on geometric constraints.
